match.os=windows: exit {code}: {tail}. `{bin}` was not found. PATH used by Atlas: {path}. Add its folder to your user Path (Environment Variables in the System settings) and restart Atlas.
match.os=*: exit {code}: {tail}. `{bin}` was not found. PATH used by Atlas: {path}. Add its directory to PATH in your shell's rc file (~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, ~/.config/fish/config.fish) and restart Atlas, or pick the right shell in Settings → Integrations → Shell & links.

tui_engine_docker_compose_missing: docker compose plugin is missing. Install docker-compose-plugin (Linux) or update Docker
tui_engine_docker_daemon_down: docker daemon is not running. Start it (Linux: sudo systemctl start docker; macOS: open OrbStack or Docker Desktop)
tui_engine_docker_not_found: docker not found. Install Docker (https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/) or fix PATH; searched: {path}
tui_engine_docker_permission: docker: permission denied on the docker socket. Add your user to the docker group: sudo usermod -aG docker $USER, then log out and in
tui_engine_docker_permission_run: docker could not be run: permission denied ({error})
tui_engine_health_hang: unhealthy: no answer from the liveness probe ({misses} misses × {timeout}s timeout)
tui_engine_health_hang_restarting: unhealthy: no answer from the liveness probe ({misses} misses × {timeout}s timeout), restarting
tui_engine_health_hang_spent: unhealthy again after its restarts: left running
tui_engine_infra_port_closed: nothing is listening on :{port} after {secs}s: the container did not start, exited, or maps another port (check `docker compose ps` and `docker compose logs`)
tui_engine_port_held: port {port} held by PID {pid} ({cmd}): stop it yourself ({stop}) or change the service port
tui_engine_port_held_cwd: port {port} held by PID {pid} ({cmd}, cwd {cwd}): stop it yourself ({stop}) or change the service port
tui_engine_sched_start_timeout_log: start timeout: still waiting for ready_log ({secs}s)
tui_engine_sched_still_starting_log: still starting after {waited}s: waiting for ready_log
tui_engine_spawn_empty_command: could not start: the service command is empty
